reason: v801 fixes a live-proven forced-login scope-isolation defect: account_public_state_v687 returns ok=true for a valid player session without enforcing site_scope_input, while v800 gejast-auth-gate.js accepted ok=true without comparing the returned session site_scope to the requested page scope. A Friends session could therefore reveal Family surfaces. v801 requires returned session scope to equal requestedScope() before reveal. Fresh exact-main Phase-1 live auth/gameplay proof remains required.
